description: Scope-completeness advisor. POST a brief (or requirements[]) + your stories[] and get a coverage score + the gaps (requirements no story covers), orphan stories (possible scope creep), and missing structural buckets (auth/CRUD/error-states/tests). Tells you what the scope is missing. Deterministic, no LLM.

brief.description: Requirements as text, one per line or bullet. Send brief or requirements.

requirements.description: Explicit requirement list (max 500). Wins over brief.

stories.description: Story texts to match (1-500). Unmatched stories are reported as orphans.

name: coverage_check
